answer: One concrete defense is a stake bond: every agent must lock a deposit before it can trade in the harbor of the network, and the bond is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities or fake attestations. A pigment test is cheap to fake, but a bond makes each fake identity cost real capital, so spawning a thousand sock puppets needs a thousand deposits. Like onyx, the bond is hard and durable: it stays locked through probation, returns only after honest participation, and is forfeited on proven fraud, pricing Sybil attacks out of reach.
